headline: Built issue #61 (rules-based JD screener, NO AI) on top of #60. New src/jdScreener.ts — pure deterministic keyword rules (sql, coding_loop [Sales/Solutions Engineer + coding-assessment], titled_years [3+ yrs impl/onboarding/PS, with the 'or trades/insurance industry' escape hatch], clearance [active only], degree/cert [with preferred/or-equivalent negation], mode remote/hybrid/onsite, travel %) → suggests blockers+mode+travel+verdict via suggestVerdict. New src/ScreenJdDialog.tsx: paste a JD → 'Suggested' badges + a 'Why' evidence list (exact matched phrase per rule) → 'Apply to this job' merges blockers with existing + stamps screenedAt; user edits after. Trigger lives in ScreeningEditor (lazy dialog). 24 table-driven screener tests incl. all the negations. Typecheck+lint+213 tests+build green; verified headless (Sales Engineer/SQL/hybrid/30% travel/degree/5+yrs JD → Reach + fields filled + persisted). PRIOR this session: #60 screening fields, #57 interop, consulting pillar, nav, redesign docs/ADR-0006. All on branch claude/apply-board-consulting-roles-xpl2a9 / PR #56.
